title: Cloud of Daggers
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (a sliver of glass)
text | You fill a 5-foot cube centered on a point you choose with spinning blades of magical energy.
text | A creature takes 4d4 slashing damage when it enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there.
text | At Higher Levels. Damage increases by 2d4 for each slot level above 2nd.

title: Crown of Madness
contents: text | One humanoid must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed.
text | While charmed, a twisted crown appears, and the target must use its action before moving to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself that you mentally choose.
text | It can act normally if no one is within reach. It may remake the save at the end of each turn.

title: Darkness
contents: text | ComponentsV, M (bat fur and a drop of pitch or coal)
text | You create a 15-foot-radius sphere of magical darkness.
text | The darkness spreads around corners and blocks even darkvision.
text | If cast on an object, the darkness moves with it. Covering the source ends the effect.
text | If the point is on a creature or carried object, it emanates darkness.

title: Enthrall
contents: text | You weave a distracting string of words.

text | Each creature of your choice within range that can hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to perceive others than you until the spell ends.

title: Gaseous Form
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (bit of gauze and wisp of smoke)
text | A willing creature becomes a misty cloud, gaining a flying speed of 10 feet and the ability to move through small holes and cracks.
text | The target has resistance to nonmagical damage, and can’t attack, cast spells, or interact with objects.

title: Hold Person
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (a small, straight piece of iron)
text | Choose one humanoid within range.
text | They must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration.
text | The creature can remake the save at the end of each turn.
text | At Higher Levels. Target one additional humanoid per slot level above 2nd.

title: Hunger of Hadar
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (a pickled octopus tentacle)
text | You open a gateway to the dark between the stars, creating a 20-foot-radius sphere of blackness and cold.
text | The area is difficult terrain and heavily obscured.
text | Any creature that starts its turn there takes 2d6 cold damage.
text | First time entering per turn = 2d6 acid damage from otherworldly tentacles.

title: Hypnotic Pattern
contents: text | ComponentsS, M (a glowing stick of incense or a crystal vial of phosphorescent material)
text | You create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air in a 30-foot cube.
text | Creatures in the area who see the pattern must make a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed and incapacitated with a speed of 0 until the spell ends or they take damage or are shaken awake.

title: Invisibility
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (an eyelash encased in gum arabic)
text | A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends.
text | The invisibility ends if the target attacks or casts a spell.
text | At Higher Levels. You can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

title: Magic Circle
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (holy water or silver dust worth 100 gp)
text | You create a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-tall cylinder that hedges out a creature type: celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead.
text | The circle can either prevent creatures from entering, trap them inside, or impose disadvantages on teleportation and possession.

title: Major Image
contents: text | You create the image of an object, creature, or phenomenon no larger than a 20-foot cube.
text | It appears real, including sound, smell, and temperature.
text | Physical interaction reveals it as an illusion.
text | A successful Investigation check against your spell DC can dispel the illusion.
text | At Higher Levels. Duration becomes permanent at 6th level slot or higher.

title: Mind Spike
contents: text | You drive a disorienting spike of psychic energy into a creature’s mind.
text | The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, taking 3d8 psychic damage on a fail, or half as much on a success.
text | On a failed save, you always know the target’s location if it’s on the same plane.
text | At Higher Levels. Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2nd.

title: Mirror Image
contents: text | Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear.
text | Each time a creature targets you with an attack, roll 1d20 to determine if it hits a duplicate.
text | Duplicates have AC 13 and are destroyed when hit. The number of duplicates affects the roll needed to misdirect an attack.

title: Misty Step
contents: text | Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
text | You must be able to see the destination clearly to teleport there.
text | This movement is teleportation; it does not provoke opportunity attacks.

title: Ray of Enfeeblement
contents: text | A black beam saps strength from a creature. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, the target deals half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength.
text | At the end of each of its turns, it can make a Constitution saving throw to end the effect.

title: Spider Climb
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (a drop of bitumen and a spider)
text | The touched creature can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving its hands free.
text | Gains a climbing speed equal to walking speed.

title: Suggestion
contents: text | Suggest a course of activity to a creature that can hear and understand you.
text | The suggestion must be worded reasonably.
text | Target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On fail, it follows the suggestion.
text | Ends early if the action is completed or if the target is harmed.
